sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.

spells.name: Slash Magic (projected slashes)
spells.note: Slash Magic page: projected slashes for mid to long range; mode 0 of the book.

spells.name: Slash Magic (forearm blades)
spells.note: Slash Magic page: large blades extended from the forearms for close combat.

spells.name: Slash Magic: Death Scythe
spells.note: A powerful slash with the forearm blades that can divide the ground. Needs the forearm blades first.

spells.name: Slash Magic (blades that adapt)
spells.note: Slash Magic page: the blades adapt to the enemy's magic (space, healing, gravity) as he fights, which is what his fights with the Zogratis showed; this mod's page for it.

spells.name: Slash Magic: Death Scythe: Lunatic Slash
spells.note: A chaotic flurry of flying slashes: the Death Scythe's later form.

spells.name: Slash Magic: Ripper Cut
spells.note: The wiki's "Ripper Cut" (named in the earlier notes of this file as planned). The effect is the mod's: a quick narrow cut.
